correctness.rationale: An independent set of G_{r,k}=K_r corona edgeless K_k contains no core vertex or exactly one; this yields I=(1+z)^{k(r−1)}((1+z)^k+r z), with −1 roots irrelevant for right-half-plane counts. At z=iy, y>0, argument of (1+iy)^k=−riy forces kθ=(4j+3)π/2 with θ=arctan y∈(0,π/2), and r=1/(sinθ cos^{k−1}θ); these are all axis crossing parameters. Derivative ∂_zQ=r(1−(k−1)z)/(1+z)≠0 on axis. Implicit derivative Re(dz/dr)=k y²/[r(1+(k−1)²y²)]>0, so each conjugate pair moves left to right. Since roots start at −1 as r→0 and degree stays fixed, full right-half-plane/root-on-axis counts follow without missed crossings. Independent NumPy root checks for k=1..12 and r=0.1,1,2,8,10,20,60,300 matched exact threshold counts; tested k=6,r=8 algebraic factor separately by SymPy. Limits: real r parameter for Q; graph only integer r.
